activity.notes: The name Muquinna/Maquinna was borne by a succession of ranking Mowachaht chiefs at Yuquot, so ATLAS does not collapse all late-eighteenth- and early-nineteenth-century references into one person. The Dictionary of Canadian Biography identifies a Muquinna who likely assumed leadership around 1778 and probably died in 1795, after which another chief took the same name/title. This Activity records only that earlier individual.

sources.title: Dictionary of Canadian Biography — MUQUINNA (Macuina, Maquilla, Maquinna), d. 1795
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography explains that Muquinna was a ranking Mowachaht/Nootka chief at Yuquot, likely assumed leadership around 1778, probably died in 1795, and was succeeded by another chief using the same name.

review_context.correction_note: Disambiguate the hereditary name/title and register the earlier Muquinna who likely died in 1795; do not merge him with the later Muquinna active during the 1803 Boston incident.
